Unevaluated integral transforms

Source: R/integrals-transforms.R
integral-transforms.Rd

LaplaceTransform(f, t, s), FourierTransform(f, x, k), MellinTransform(f, x, s), SineTransform(), CosineTransform(), HankelTransform(f, r, k, nu) and their inverses are unevaluated transform objects; doit() computes them with laplace_transform(), fourier_transform() and the other transform functions. InverseLaplaceTransform() takes an optional plane (ignored), and InverseMellinTransform() the strip a, b.

Usage

LaplaceTransform(f, t, s)

InverseLaplaceTransform(f, s, t, plane = NULL)

FourierTransform(f, x, k)

InverseFourierTransform(f, k, x)

MellinTransform(f, x, s)

InverseMellinTransform(f, s, x, a, b)

SineTransform(f, x, k)

InverseSineTransform(f, k, x)

CosineTransform(f, x, k)

InverseCosineTransform(f, k, x)

HankelTransform(f, r, k, nu)

InverseHankelTransform(f, k, r, nu)

Arguments

f

The function.

t, s, x, k, r

Variables: the original first, the transformed second.

plane

Ignored.

a, b

The fundamental strip.

nu

The Bessel order.

Value

A transform object.

Examples

t <- Symbol("t", positive = TRUE); s <- Symbol("s")
L <- LaplaceTransform(t^2, t, s)
doit(L)
#> 2/s^3
latex(L)
#> [1] "\\mathcal{L}_{t}\\left[t^{2}\\right]\\left(s\\right)"
